newsitem.title: USA: Porta says auditors express doubts.
newsitem.headline: Porta says auditors express doubts.

text.p: Porta Systems Corp said the report of its auditors for 1996, BDO Seidman, states that continuing losses before non-recurring gains, combined with the need for the company to refinance or restructure certain notes due on January 2, 1998, raise substantial doubt as to the company's ability to continue as a going concern.

Although the company reported operating income of $3,982,000 for the year ended December 31, 1996, as compared with a loss of $19,884,000, it sustained a loss of $1,210,000 after deducting interest expense and before adding the positive effects of a gain on the sale of assets relating to discontinued Israeli operations and extraordinary items.
The company said that its 1995 auditors' report was also modified to state that recurring losses from operations raised substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a "going concern."

As previously reported, the company does not presently satisfy all of the American Stock Exchange's financial guidelines for continuing listing of its common stock. In the event this situation is not remedied, it said there can be no assurance that the listing of its common stock will continue.
